_comment: Alias table for genuine synonyms that cannot be inferred from spelling alone (different words for the same concept, e.g. 'EC' and 'Web' both meaning the online channel). Spelling/whitespace/width variants (e.g. 'シブヤ店' vs '渋谷店', '横浜店 ' vs '横浜店') are resolved automatically by build_sales_report.py and do NOT need an entry here. Edit this file, not the script, when a genuinely new synonym shows up in future months' raw data.
